detail.title: 16CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 1.5U 4HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5416L-I3 16CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 1.5U 4HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 16-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 5M-N@12fps/1080p@15fps Encoding Capability • Max. 24-ch IP Video Input (Up to 8MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 4-ch Perimeter Protection, 16-ch SMD, 16-ch AI Coding • 4 Bays. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Mode: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels(up to 12 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

AI Video Quality Analytics.AI Video Quality Analytics by Recorder: 16 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast levels, black and white

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 24 channels of IPC access 8 IP channels by default + 16 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 128 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, SMD, Perimeter Protection and QuickPick 2.0 cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: 5 MP Mode: 4-ch 5 MP@(1 fps-6 fps); others 5M-N@(1 fps-12 fps) 5M-N Mode: 5M-N@(1 fps –12 fps); 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps)
Audio and Video.Video Output: 2 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 CVBS HDMI1: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA/HDMI2: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 It changes to 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 when Face, IVS&SMD or Quick Pick is selected in AI Mode. *Heterogeneous video sources output for HDMI2 is configurable.
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK
Network.Network Mode: Multi-address mode; fault tolerance; load balance

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; alarm; motion detection; intelligent; POS
Recording Playback.Recording Playback: 1/4/9/16 It changes to 1/4/9 split when Face or IVS&SMD is selected in AI Mode.
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Disk Interface: 4 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
Ports.USB: 3(1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports)

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
